newsitem.title: UK: BBC wins 44 pct of UK television audience in 1996.
newsitem.headline: BBC wins 44 pct of UK television audience in 1996.

text.p: The BBC won 44 percent of the British television audience in 1996, followed by ITV with 35 percent, Britain's Independent Television Commission reported.
BBC1, the BBC's flagship station, claimed a 32.5 percent audience share in 1996. BBC2, which caters to a niche audience, claimed 11.5 percent of the viewing audience, the ITC said.
ITV, the mass-market, commercial Independent Television Network which includes multiple regional licensees as well as GMTV, won a total audience share of 35 percent.
Channel 4, the state-controlled, commercial network which has a remit to offer alternative programming to ITV, won 10.2 percent of the audience, the ITC said.
The remainder of the viewing audience was claimed by satellite and cable channels.
